dict.（我的补充，复刻固件时发现）octopus_bus.h 的私有 Write(): (My addition, found while recreating the firmware) The private Write() in octopus_bus.h returns true (== 0) on success, but Init() tests "Write(...) != 0" for failure: a successful write returns false, so as written Init always fails and the serial port keeps printing "init failed".
